description.narrative: KIM ENTERPRISES addresses the pest control challenges in Cte d'Ivoire's agri-food industry by implementing an integrated and sustainable approach. Our solution involves: pest management plans: We will conduct on-site assessments to understand the specific challenges faced by plants and processing units in the San Pedro and Abidjan region. Subsequently, we will develop customized pest management plans, using a combination of ecological techniques and innovative technologies. Our approach includes training of stakeholders and staff in the processing unit on effective pest management methods, with an emphasis on using environmentally friendly practices. This capacity-building initiative aims to equip local stakeholders with the knowledge and skills necessary for sustainable pest management.Ongoing monitoring and innovation: We will implement a comprehensive monitoring system to track the effectiveness of our pest management strategies. Continuous .research and innovation will be an integral part of adapting our methods and long-term success.Innovation lies in our holistic and localized approach, combining tailor-made solutions, .capacity building and continuous innovation. We anticipate a 15% reduction in post harvest losses over the two-year subsidy period, which will benefit farmers, processors and the entire San Pedro area community. Ultimately, our goal is to create a more resilient and sustainable agri-food industry in Cte d'Ivoire by setting new pest management standards and contributing to the economic well-being of local communities. Opportunities for our services are important given the demand for effective and sustainable pest management solutions in the agri-food sector.
